limits: Full checkpoints are 50.5–60.7 MB, including resident data; sampled retained bytes include diagnostic reference/initial/final checkpoints as well as the correction ring.
Capture costs include a complete function-table audit; intermediate presentation timings include renderer reconstruction, draw, disposal and restoring its pre-draw checkpoint.
Timing includes deliberate 16-ms scheduling waits and only one presentation per 60 forward frames. It does not establish displayed 60 FPS or input-to-photon latency.
Native drawing mutates WASM; discarding those mutations after drawing still needs an audit for game-relevant render dependencies.
Corrected canvas screenshots show fighters/HUD, but no retail pixel-parity comparison or exhaustive roster/move/interaction coverage was performed.
No connection to production room inputs, confirmed-event audio, speculative result commitment, or reconnect recovery.
The local test-only relay injects delay/reordering over WebSocket; no actual WAN or packet-loss/retransmission test.
No extracted assets, game data, binaries or snapshot contents are included in this report.
